question: The number a lab wants, in kN, is the total mount load: 2 kN of static preload plus the combined drive force on 11 identical sliders, expressed in kN. Each slider has a mass of 15000 grams, and its drive force is the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is 20 less than the area under the curve y = 4x^2 + 1x between x = 2 and x = 4. What total mount load, in kN, does the lab record?

A lab bench launches a 7000 gram puck at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. A tray holds 11 identical pucks, and a rack holds 3 identical trays; the combined energy of motion of a rack, less 24 J absorbed by the rack's foam liner, is the rack's net energy. The bench processes 5 identical racks. What is the total net energy, in J, for the 5 racks?

A parcel conveyor drives totes of mass 39000 grams along a belt 25 m long. Each tote's acceleration in m/s^2 is 5 times the largest whole number that divides both 261 and 367 exactly. The drive on each tote must supply the force producing that acceleration plus 28 N of belt friction. The conveyor drives 6 identical totes at once, and a tensioner relieves 11 N of the combined drive. What net drive force, in N, does the conveyor supply?

A test sled of mass 13000 grams slides along a bench 4 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A logger adds 29 kJ for the bench's stored capacitor energy and then subtracts 17 kJ drawn off by the cooling system. What figure, in kJ, does the logger show?

A pick-and-place robot accelerates a 10000 gram tray along a rail. The tray's acceleration in m/s^2 is the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 5. The rail mount carries the force producing that acceleration, plus 18 N of guide friction, plus 11 N from a cable chain. Express the total mount load in kN.

A bottling plant accelerates crates of mass 73000 grams along a line 18 m long. Each crate's acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 2x between x = 1 and x = 3, and each crate is pushed with the force producing that acceleration. A pusher handles 3 crates, a line has 10 identical pushers, and the line's frame also carries 22 N from a tensioning spring on top of the combined push. The plant runs 8 identical lines. What total force, in N, do the frames of all 8 lines carry?

The figure a print-shop manager wants, in kN, is the combined net drive of 7 identical presses, each press's net drive expressed in kN. A press's net drive is the combined push on its 3 identical carriages minus 23 N supplied by a return spring. Each carriage has a mass of 24 kg and a bed 1.4 m wide, and the push on each is the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0. What combined net drive, in kN, does the manager report?

A test sled of mass 19000 grams is launched at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 15. Its energy of motion at launch, less 28 J absorbed by the launch cradle, is expressed in kJ as the net launch energy. There are 7 identical launches in a session. What is the total net launch energy for the session, in kJ?

A warehouse robot of mass 30 kg moves along an aisle 60 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the largest whole number that divides both 49 and 180 exactly. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 19 kJ of stored battery energy is added to give one robot's energy budget. An aisle holds 12 identical robots, and the warehouse has 4 identical aisles. What is the total energy budget, in kJ, of all the robots?

A pneumatic launcher on a factory floor fires test carts of mass 29 kg along a rail 6 m long. Each cart's acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 12x + 32 = 0, multiplying by 8, and adding 16. The launcher fires 8 identical carts at once, each with the force producing that acceleration. What total force, in N, does the launcher exert?

A test drone of mass 26000 grams and rotor span 1.1 m flies at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 15, reduced by 13. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A squadron is 10 identical drones, and the fleet has 10 identical squadrons. What is the total energy of motion of the fleet, in kJ?

A sled of mass 37000 grams runs on a track 20 m long at a speed in m/s equal to 5 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. Three identical sleds run at once. What is the combined energy of motion of the 3 sleds, in kJ?

A scale rally-car model of mass 41 kg is timed on a straight. Its speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 1 and x = 3. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A test session is 9 identical runs; the team adds 18 kJ for the energy in the starter battery and subtracts 6 kJ absorbed by the finish-line barrier. What session figure, in kJ, does the team record?

The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is the net energy of a batch: the combined energy of motion of 11 identical pucks, less 7 J absorbed by the catch pad, expressed in kJ. Each puck has a mass of 9 kg. The pucks' speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 1 s of a cart whose position in metres is s(t) = 4t^3 - 1t^2 with t in seconds. What net batch energy, in kJ, does the lab record?

A luggage carousel drives trays of mass 94000 grams. Each tray's acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 302 and 275 exactly. A segment drives 4 identical trays, each with the force producing that acceleration, and the segment's frame adds 30 N of guide friction to the combined push. The carousel has 10 identical segments. Express the total load on all 10 segments in kN.

A hospital supply cart of mass 109000 grams runs along a level corridor rail, and its position in metres after t seconds is s(t) = 1t^3 + 2t^2. The tow cable must transmit the force producing the cart's acceleration at t = 1 s plus 1 N of pulley friction, and this cable load is expressed in kN. The cable's anchor also carries 12 kN of static structure load in addition to the cable load. What total load, in kN, does the anchor carry?

The number a logistics hub wants, in J, is the grand total over 10 identical shifts, each shift covering 4 identical lines, each line running 11 identical carts, every cart contributing the same energy figure. A cart's energy figure is its energy of motion plus 25 J stored in its brake spring. Each cart has a mass of 33000 grams. Each cart's speed in m/s is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 8 = 0. What grand total, in J, does the hub report?

A sled of mass 64000 grams is accelerated along a level rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 8 times the sum of 5 and 1, reduced by 27. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a booster spring, which contributes 24 N, and the rest comes through the tow cable; the cable's contribution is expressed in kN. The cable's load cell has a zero offset of 2 kN, so its reading is the cable contribution minus 2 kN (a negative reading is possible). What does the load cell read, in kN?

A robotic welder carriage of mass 38000 grams travels along a level gantry 12 m long, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 3t^3 + 0t^2. The gantry mount carries the force producing the carriage's acceleration at t = 1 s, expressed in kN. To that the mount adds 10 kN of clamping load, then a counterweight relieves 18 kN, and finally a hydraulic preload adds 22 kN. What net load, in kN, does the gantry mount carry?

The figure a drone-range manager wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is the grand energy balance: 8 identical days, each day being 5 identical flights, each flight's balance being the drone's energy of motion expressed in kJ minus 8 kJ drawn from its battery. The drone has a mass of 8 kg and a wingspan of 1.5 m. Its speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 2x between x = 0 and x = 3. What grand energy balance, in kJ, does the manager record?

A test kart of mass 33 kg runs on a circuit 300 m long. Its speed in m/s is found by taking the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0, subtracting 12, and then adding 24. The kart's energy of motion at that speed is expressed in kJ, and the 16 kJ drawn from its battery to reach that speed is subtracted to give the energy balance (negative meaning a net loss). What is the energy balance, in kJ?

The number a test-track engineer wants, in kJ, is the energy of motion of a 44000 gram sled at its run speed. The run speed in m/s is 6 times a base figure. The base figure is obtained by taking the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 7x between x = 0 and x = 1, adding 15, and then subtracting 6. What energy of motion, in kJ, does the engineer record?

A kart-track conveyor accelerates karts of mass 20 kg along a lane 35 m long. Each kart's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. A lane carries 12 identical karts, and the conveyor runs 2 identical lanes. The conveyor frame also carries 25 kN of static load on top of the combined drive force. What total load, in kN, does the frame carry?

A luggage tug pulls carts of mass 65 kg across an apron 45 m wide. Each cart's acceleration in m/s^2 is 11 more than the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 7 = 0. The tug pulls 8 identical carts, each with the force producing that acceleration. Express the tug's total pull in kN.

The number a marina wants, in kJ, is the combined energy of motion of the tenders on 2 identical docks, each dock holding 4 identical tenders, each tender's energy of motion expressed in kJ. Each tender has a mass of 49000 grams. The tenders' speed in m/s is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 13x + 42 = 0. What combined energy, in kJ, does the marina record?
